question: A train covers a distance of 56 km in 35 minutes. Travelling at the same speed, in how many seconds will the train cover a distance of 720 metres?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the train = 56 km

Time taken to cover the distance = 35 minutes

Distance to be covered = 720 meters

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Convert 56 km to meters:

56 km = 56 × 1000 = 56000 meters

Convert 35 minutes to seconds:

35 minutes = 35 × 60 = 2100 seconds

Calculate the speed of the train:

Speed = Distance / Time

Speed = 56000 / 2100

Speed = (56000)/(2100)

Simplify the fraction:

Speed = (56000)/(2100) = (560)/(21) meters/second

Calculate the time to cover 720 meters:

Time = Distance / Speed

Time = 720 / ((560)/(21))

⇒ Time = 720 × (21)/(560)

⇒ Time = 720 × (3)/(80)

⇒ Time = 27 seconds

**The train will cover a distance of 720 meters in 27 seconds.**
